info.title: Wii U Album
info.author: SudoTronics
info.description: Manage screenshots/videos on your Wii U
info.details:
An album app for the Wii U. Browse, view, edit, and wirelessly transfer your screenshots and videos to a smart device.

Features :

view screenshots and videos stored in : /fs/vol/external01/wiiu/screenshots (Screenshotplugin) /fs/vol/external01/wiiu/videos (Screencaptureplugin)

Filter by media type, application name, sort by date (newest/oldest)

Video Clipping : Trim videos with visual timeline and preview and export as a new video.

Image Editor : Add customizable text to screenshots.

QR Code Transfer : Scan QR code with a smart device to transfer media.
Supports single and multi-file transfers (up to 5 files)
